articles.title: Grindr's AJ Balance on Freddie Deal and Expanding HIV Prevention
articles.summary:
In this NYSE Live interview, AJ Balance, Chief Product Officer at Grindr, discusses the company's agreement to acquire Freddie and how the transaction supports Grindr's long-term health and wellness strategy.
